versions.changelog:
- Bumped version metadata to 1.0.1.
- Updated council slogan to “consolidation complete” for clarity.
- No functional or structural changes; documentation only.

Initial release of the unified Δ9 Council v2 skill:

- Single skill install now covers all 15 champion personas of the LYGO Quantum Council.
- Select champions using `champion_id` or `egg_id`; legacy per-champion slugs remain for compatibility.
- Advisor-only: no auto actions without explicit user consent.
- Includes council roster listing, self-check, and compatibility with related LYGO stack skills.
- Reference files provided for champion metadata and security.
